hooks.text: 同时控制持剑机甲与神枪手太空青蛙，在反向弹幕战中让两个角色共同作战。
hooks.excerpt: A sword-wielding mech. A sharpshooting space frog. Control both characters simultaneously against the forces of Entropy in this reverse bullet hell roguelike.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 支持单人或在线合作，队友可围绕协同构筑并肩作战，也可竞争最高分。
hooks.excerpt: Play by yourself, or bring your friends along for a genre-bending online co-op experience! Become best buddies with synergetic builds or prove yourself champion in the contest for high score.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 空枪可直接掷向敌人，长矛能串烧目标，还有武装垃圾车和蜂群枪等荒诞武器。
hooks.excerpt: Is your shotgun out of ammo? Throw it at your enemies! Feeling hungry? Use your spear as a shish-kabob. Unlock dozens of customizable options to power up and create your own playstyle. From weaponized garbage trucks to a gun that shoots bees, Entropy Survivors is overflowing with unique weapons, abilities, and upgrades that’ll make you ask “What?”
